about: The shape of strokes: their turns (corners and bends), shapes, zones crossed, rests and moves, as the gesture tracker reads them. Written from mockup/src/libs/spatial/gestures/ by tools/make-gesture-vectors.js. Each case gives the settings and the screen's height, then its input in order. Before each input, time runs on to its t in ticks of the clock: one every 25 ms after the previous input, and one at the input's own time; holds and rests are seen on the ticks. Then the input is applied: down (with its button: 2 is the right), move, up or cancel, or none, when only time passes. A floor point g carries its zone, zone, which stands in for what a user hands in (zoneAt()). Each event gives its type, the pointer's id, the time, the pointer's state and where it was (x, y), and what the event says. Times and angles to 1e-9.
